review: Agent inspection of original artwork and actual native captures; not a human usability study
observations: All app tiles retain readable full Start labels and distinct recognizable silhouettes in light and dark; taskbar/title-bar identities are consistent.
Original host contact sheets are artwork/raster review, while the feature image is an actual owned QEMU installed guest.
Native file and USB rows retain clear name/icon spacing; the corrected dark audio/archive/standalone inks remain readable without lightening saturated app tile backgrounds.
Devices retains explicit capability text beside category icons, including software 2D and the absence of GPU acceleration.
Actual HiDPI captures use physical-density antialiasing rather than resized icons. Later M12 stages still own broader desktop, Files/USB and taskbar layout changes.
retained_limits: Earlier candidate BIOS timeout remains unresolved and separately documented; scoped successful guest journeys are not stress-reliability or universal hardware proof.
